---
title: "What if the UK used a different voting system?"
author: "Oliver Porter"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

ge2024_raw = read_csv("data/HoC-GE2024-results-by-constituency.csv")

names(ge2024_raw)   # check the real column names first

ge2024 = ge2024_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = Con:`All other candidates`,   # the party vote columns
    names_to = "party",
    values_to = "votes"
  ) %>%
  mutate(election = 2024)
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
